title: Depression and Anxiety in Adolescents: Not a Mood, but an Illness
summary: Teenage depression: sadness/emptiness > two weeks, loss of enjoyment, fatigue, changes in sleep/appetite, poor concentration, negative thoughts. Anxiety: persistent tension, expecting disaster, avoiding situations. It is not a "mood" or "weakness of iman" — it is a chemical/psychological imbalance. Treatment: Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT) + medication if needed + family support. Parents: listen without judgment, reassure: "It is an illness like any other, and it has a cure."
try_this: This week: simplified PHQ-9/GAD-7 scale (9/7 questions) — complete it with your child confidentially. If the score is >10: schedule an appointment with a pediatrician or mental health specialist.
reflection_prompts: What was the highest score on the scale?
Did your child feel at ease after the conversation?
